root_cause_criterion.criterion: When `loadLabel()` exits through `EOF` on the embedded `scalebar->label`, it must preserve the owner's live reference so the later cleanup sink still sees `label->refcount == 1`. The vulnerable EOF arm consumes that reference in place by calling `freeLabel(label)` before returning `-1`.
root_cause_criterion.description: The selected root obligation is that the EOF arm of `loadLabel()` must not decrement the embedded label's ownership state before owner cleanup runs. On the original fixed execution, the same malformed input reaches the EOF return with `label->refcount == 1`; on the vulnerable execution, the same point is reached only after the in-place free has already driven `label->refcount` to 0.

nodes.state: During the later owner cleanup traversal, the sink line reuses `label->styles` as the base pointer for the `label->styles[i]` read. On the vulnerable execution, that base is the already-freed styles array reported by AddressSanitizer.

edges.relation: After the EOF arm frees the embedded label in place, the same `label->styles` base pointer is carried unchanged to the later `freeLabel()` sink line, so the second cleanup reads through the array pointer that the earlier `freeLabel(label)` already released.
